latest_release.name: Marker v2.2.0 — 4 Conversion Modes, In-Process Indra ONNX Engine, Interactive Web Viewer & 88.9% on OmniParseBench
latest_release.body:
# Marker v2.2.0 — 4 Conversion Modes, In-Process Indra ONNX Engine, Interactive Web Viewer & 88.9% on OmniParseBench

Marker `2.2.0` is our biggest architecture and usability upgrade since Marker 2.0:

- **Up to 20× faster CPU conversion (`7–33 pages/s`) with zero external servers** via the new in-process **Indra ONNX** layout, reading order, and OCR engine (`fast` and `no_ocr` modes).
- **88.9% on [OmniParseBench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/datalab-to/omni_parse_bench)** in `balanced` mode — routing clean digital pages through `pdftext` + Indra ONNX and routing tables, math, CJK/non-Latin scripts, and scanned pages to **Surya 2.5 VLM** (`86.7%` in pure `vllm` mode), outperforming Docling (`74.9%`) and PaddleOCR-VL (`84.4%`).
- **New built-in Interactive Web Viewer (`marker_gui` & `marker_server`)** — replaces the legacy Streamlit app with a fast, self-contained browser UI featuring interactive SVG layout/line/reading-order overlays, stage timing bars, and `Preview` / `Markdown` / `Blocks` / `Lines` / `HTML` / `Chunks` / `JSON` inspection tabs.
- **Agent-ready CLI (`--stdout`, `--skill`, `--install_skill`, `--recursive`, `--skip_existing`)** — pipe converted output directly to `stdout` or install the bundled AI agent skill (`SKILL.md`) for Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity in one command.

> Need handwriting, complex forms, or managed VLM parsing at scale? Try **[Chandra on the Datalab API](https://www.datalab.to/?utm_source=gh-marker-release)** — get **5,000 free pages every month** when you sign up with a work email.

---

## 1. Four Conversion Modes (`--mode no_ocr | fast | balanced | vllm`)

Marker now automatically picks the best mode for your hardware (`balanced` on CUDA GPUs, `fast` on CPU / Apple Silicon), or you can select any mode explicitly via `--mode`:

| Mode | Speed (GH200 / CPU) | OmniParseBench | How It Works & When to Use |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- |
| **`no_ocr`** | **32.7 pg/s** | 71.1% | Pure embedded PDF text layer (`pdftext`) + in-process Indra ONNX layout & reading order on CPU. Zero OCR calls. Ideal for born-digital PDFs when maximum CPU throughput is needed. |
| **`fast`** | **7.0–33 pg/s** | 83.2% | In-process Indra ONNX layout, reading order, and ONNX line/page OCR on CPU/MPS/GPU. **Requires no external VLM server.** Default on CPU and Apple Silicon. |
| **`balanced`** | **2.9 pg/s** | **88.9%** | Hybrid routing: `pdftext` + Indra ONNX on clean Latin prose pages; routes tables, math/equations, CJK/non-Latin scripts, and scanned/garbled pages to **Surya 2.5 VLM**. Default on CUDA GPUs. |
| **`vllm`** | **2.5 pg/s** | **86.7%** | Full-page **Surya 2.5 VLM** OCR on every page, skipping `pdftext` and Indra entirely. Best for degraded scans, dense math, and complex multi-script layouts. |

### OmniParseBench Comparison (838 pages, 15,834 unit tests)

| Parser | Headline | Text | Tables | Math | Layout | Order | Pages/s |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **Marker 2.2 (`balanced`)** | **88.9** | **93.5** | **89.0** | 75.7 | **92.8** | **92.4** | 2.9 |
| **Marker 2.2 (`vllm`)** | 86.7 | 92.8 | 88.2 | **78.0** | 89.8 | 91.6 | 2.5 |
| PaddleOCR-VL 1.5 | 84.4 | 92.1 | 83.1 | 76.2 | 82.9 | 89.2 | 1.1 |
| **Marker 2.2 (`fast` - CPU ONNX)** | 83.2 | 90.2 | 81.2 | 66.2 | 91.2 | 90.5 | **7.0** |
| Docling | 74.9 | 84.9 | 78.2 | 35.1 | 81.4 | 85.4 | 1.4 |
| **Marker 2.2 (`no_ocr` - CPU)** | 71.1 | 79.1 | 69.2 | 47.0 | 88.2 | 87.0 | **32.7** |

---

## 2. Built-In Interactive Web Viewer (`marker_gui` & `marker_server`)

Run `marker_gui --port 8000` (or `marker_server --port 8000` for the FastAPI REST server + viewer + `/docs`) to inspect documents page by page in your browser:

- Drag & drop PDFs, images, `DOCX`, `PPTX`, `XLSX`, `HTML`, or `EPUB` files.
- Switch live between `Auto`, `No OCR`, `Fast`, `Balanced`, and `vLLM` modes.
- Interactive SVG overlays for **layout blocks**, **block labels**, **reading order**, and **text lines** with bidirectional hover highlighting.
